name: Few-View Reconstruction via Regularization
definition: A family of approaches to mitigate shape-radiance ambiguity in NeRF when supervision from multiple viewpoints is sparse, preventing overfitting to observed views and improving generalization to unseen ones.
summary: Few-View Reconstruction via Regularization mitigates NeRF ambiguity by applying geometric or semantic priors to stabilize optimization, distinguishing itself from progressive methods that restrain model capacity early in training.
